# Contribution Guidelines

Thank you for considering contributing to MAVEX! We welcome contributions from all engineers, developers, and subject matter experts. Our goal is to maintain a high standard of excellence, reliability, and clarity across all aspects of the project.

Contributing to MAVEX involves more than just submitting code or files; it requires an understanding of our standards, our workflow, and our overall mission. By following this guide, you will ensure your contributions integrate seamlessly and enhance the project quality for everyone.

## Overall Coventions to be followed
- Please use `snake-case` for filenames
- Please markdown properly
- Please raise a PR

## Specific Conventions

### Documentation
- Please check out the documentation structure and add your documentation files appropriately.
- The documentation should be in `.qmd` format.
- Scientific Calculations should be documented in python notebooks
- Inventory management is in `.csv` files which then generates other inventory reporting using python notebooks

### Minutes of Meetings
- Please file minutes of meetings in markdown format 
- The file should be named as follows `mmddYYYY.md`

### Source Code
Please submit source code in src folder under language name. Python is preferred.

### Design Files
Please submit designs to thingiverse with the hyperlink mentioned in the documentation folder
